summary: REQ-2 (serif + lighter font weight for quote text) is partially implemented — Playfair Display is used via font-serif and font-thin (weight 100), but the requirement asks for weight 300 or 400, not 100. REQ-1 (thinner borders) shows border classes like border-border/20 in NFTCollectionCard and NFTCollectionsSection, but no explicit reduction to 1px or 0.5px is visible in the Gallery page itself, and no previous border values are shown to confirm they were reduced.

missing_requirements.requirement: Reduce the border widths on the Gallery page further — must be noticeably thinner (1px or 0.5px or less).
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows border-border/20 utility classes in NFTCollectionCard and NFTCollectionsSection, but the Gallery.tsx page itself has no explicit border width changes. There is no evidence that borders were previously thicker and have now been reduced to 1px or less on the Gallery page specifically.

missing_requirements.requirement: Quote text font-weight must be 300 or 400 (lighter than previous).
missing_requirements.reason: The quote paragraph uses font-thin which maps to font-weight: 100 in Tailwind. The AC requires font-weight 300 or 400. Using weight 100 does not satisfy the stated acceptance criteria.
